# ==============================================================================
# BLOC 8 — Espèces Indicatrices par sites (Avec Lyvet)
# ==============================================================================

# Pour chaque espèce, multipatt combine fidélité (fréquence de détection dans les PCRs du site) et spécificité (proportion de ses détections concentrées dans ce site).
# IndVal = Fidélité × Spécificité. Seules les espèces associées à un seul site (p ≤ 0.05, 9999 permutations) sont retenues. 
# Travaille sur PCRs individuels (pas de pooling) car la fidélité nécessite la variabilité entre réplicats pour être calculée.

```{r}
# IndVal per site
phy_sp_iv  <- tax_glom(physeq_teleo, taxrank="Species", NArm=TRUE)
phy_sp_iv  <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(phy_sp_iv)>0, phy_sp_iv)
phy_pa_iv  <- transform_sample_counts(phy_sp_iv, function(x) ifelse(x>0,1,0))
otu_iv     <- as.data.frame(otu_table(phy_pa_iv))
if(taxa_are_rows(phy_pa_iv)) otu_iv <- t(otu_iv)
tax_iv     <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy_pa_iv))
sp_full_iv <- paste(tax_iv$Genus, tax_iv$Species)
colnames(otu_iv) <- sp_full_iv

meta_iv      <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_pa_iv))
meta_iv$Site <- trimws(meta_iv$Site)
site_factor  <- factor(meta_iv$Site, levels=site_order)

set.seed(seed_global)
cat("\n=== IndVal per site ===\n")
indval_site <- multipatt(otu_iv, site_factor,
                          func="IndVal.g", control=how(nperm=n_perm_indval))
summary(indval_site, alpha=0.05, indvalcomp=TRUE)

s_cols   <- grep("^s\\.",colnames(indval_site$sign),value=TRUE)
site_nms <- trimws(gsub("^s\\.","",s_cols))

indval_df <- data.frame(Species=rownames(indval_site$sign),
                          indval_site$sign,stringsAsFactors=FALSE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(p.value), p.value<=0.05) %>%
  mutate(n_sites    = rowSums(across(all_of(s_cols))),
         Site_assoc = apply(across(all_of(s_cols)),1,function(x){
           idx <- which(x==1)
           if(length(idx)==0) return(NA)
           paste(site_nms[idx],collapse=" + ")})) %>%
  filter(n_sites==1) %>%
  mutate(Site_assoc  = factor(trimws(Site_assoc),levels=site_order),
         stat        = round(stat,3),
         p.value     = round(p.value,4),
         p_label     = case_when(
           p.value<0.0001 ~ "p=1e-04",
           p.value<0.001  ~ paste0("p=",formatC(p.value,format="e",digits=0)),
           TRUE           ~ paste0("p=",p.value)),
         Common_name = sapply(Species, get_nom_commun)) %>%
  arrange(Site_assoc, desc(stat))

cat("\nNb indicator species:", nrow(indval_df), "\n")
if(nrow(indval_df)>0){
  cat("\nNb per site:\n"); print(table(indval_df$Site_assoc))
  site_colors_iv <- setNames(
    brewer.pal(max(3,length(site_order)),"Set2"), site_order)
  p_indval <- ggplot(indval_df,
         aes(x=stat, y=reorder(Common_name,stat), fill=Site_assoc)) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity", width=0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(label=p_label), hjust=-0.1, size=2.8, color="grey30") +
    facet_wrap(~Site_assoc, scales="free_y", ncol=2,
               labeller=as_labeller(site_labels_court)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=site_colors_iv) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title   ="Indicator species by site (IndVal.g)",
         subtitle="Species associated with a single site | p ≤ 0.05",
         x="IndVal", y=NULL) +
    theme(legend.position="none",
          strip.text=element_text(face="bold",size=9),
          plot.title=element_text(face="bold",size=11))
  print(p_indval)
  pdf(file.path(rep_racine, "Fig_Bloc8_IndVal_per_site.pdf"),
      width=10, height=8)
  print(p_indval)
  dev.off()
}

```

# ==============================================================================
# BLOC 9 — Tests de Mantel (distance-decay)
# ==============================================================================

# Ce bloc teste si la dissimilarité des communautés entre sites augmente avec la distance géographique ==> patron de distance-decay attendu le long d'un gradient estuarien.
#
# Même matrice d'entrée que betapart : site × espèce P/A poolée par max. La dissimilarité de Sørensen entre chaque paire de sites est corrélée à leur distance géographique
# absolue en km (|distance_i - distance_j|) via le test de Mantel (corrélation de Pearson, 9999 permutations). Les permutations mélangent aléatoirement les étiquettes de
# site pour construire une distribution nulle et tester si la corrélation observée est significative.
#
# Figure 1 : global avec vs sans Lyvet → 10 paires de sites.
# Figure 2 : par capsule sans Lyvet → 10 paires par capsule.
# Le coefficient r de Mantel mesure la force du distance-decay
# et la p-value sa significativité.

```{r bloc8_mantel, eval=run_bloc8_mantel}

library(indicspecies)

if(!exists("mat_sp"))    mat_sp    <- prep_betapart_matrix(physeq_teleo)
if(!exists("mat_sp_nl")) mat_sp_nl <- prep_betapart_matrix(
  prune_samples(sample_data(physeq_teleo)$Site!="Lyvet", physeq_teleo))

run_mantel <- function(mat_pa, label) {
  sites_p  <- intersect(site_order, rownames(mat_pa))
  dist_geo <- as.dist(outer(
    meta_sites$Distance[match(sites_p,meta_sites$Site)],
    meta_sites$Distance[match(sites_p,meta_sites$Site)],
    function(a,b) abs(a-b)))
  dist_eco <- vegdist(mat_pa[sites_p,], method="bray", binary=TRUE)
  cat("\n=== Mantel —", label, "===\n"); set.seed(seed_global)
  mtest <- mantel(dist_eco, dist_geo, method="pearson",
                  permutations=n_perm_mantel)
  print(mtest)
  data.frame(label=label, r_mantel=round(mtest$statistic,3),
             p_value=round(mtest$signif,4))
}

mantel_full <- run_mantel(mat_sp,    "Global — with Lyvet")
mantel_nl   <- run_mantel(mat_sp_nl, "Global — without Lyvet")

#  Figure 1: 2 regression lines — Global WITH Lyvet vs WITHOUT Lyvet 
sites_full  <- rownames(mat_sp)
dist_sp_geo <- outer(meta_sites$Distance, meta_sites$Distance,
                      function(a,b) abs(a-b))
dist_sp_eco <- as.matrix(vegdist(mat_sp, method="bray", binary=TRUE))

# Dataset WITH Lyvet — tous les paires
pairs_with <- data.frame(
  dist_geo = dist_sp_geo[lower.tri(dist_sp_geo)],
  dist_eco = dist_sp_eco[lower.tri(dist_sp_eco)],
  Courbe   = "With Lyvet")

# Dataset WITHOUT Lyvet
sites_nl_fig1  <- rownames(mat_sp_nl)
dist_geo_nl1   <- outer(
  meta_sites$Distance[match(sites_nl_fig1, meta_sites$Site)],
  meta_sites$Distance[match(sites_nl_fig1, meta_sites$Site)],
  function(a,b) abs(a-b))
dist_eco_nl1   <- as.matrix(vegdist(mat_sp_nl, method="bray", binary=TRUE))
pairs_without  <- data.frame(
  dist_geo = dist_geo_nl1[lower.tri(dist_geo_nl1)],
  dist_eco = dist_eco_nl1[lower.tri(dist_eco_nl1)],
  Courbe   = "Without Lyvet")

pairs_fig1_both <- rbind(pairs_with, pairs_without) %>%
  mutate(Courbe = factor(Courbe, levels = c("With Lyvet", "Without Lyvet")))

colors_fig1 <- c("With Lyvet"    = "#333333",
                  "Without Lyvet" = "#1f78b4")

# Labels Mantel pour la légende inline
label_with    <- paste0("r = ", mantel_full$r_mantel, "  /  p ", mantel_full$p_value)
label_without <- paste0("r = ", mantel_nl$r_mantel,   "  /  p < ", mantel_nl$p_value)

p_fig1_mantel <- ggplot(pairs_fig1_both,
    aes(x = dist_geo, y = dist_eco, color = Courbe, fill = Courbe)) +
  # Points neutres gris clair en arrière-plan
  geom_point(size = 2.0, alpha = 0.40) +
  # 2 droites de régression avec IC 95%
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1.4, alpha = 0.15) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = colors_fig1,
    name   = NULL,
    labels = c(
      "With Lyvet"    = paste0("With Lyvet       ", label_with),
      "Without Lyvet" = paste0("Without Lyvet  ", label_without))) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = colors_fig1,
    name   = NULL,
    labels = c(
      "With Lyvet"    = paste0("With Lyvet       ", label_with),
      "Without Lyvet" = paste0("Without Lyvet  ", label_without))) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.05)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  labs(title    = "1 — Distance-decay: with vs without Lyvet",
       subtitle = "Sørensen P/A | Species level | 95% CI",
       x = "Geographic distance (km)",
       y = "Dissimilarity (Sørensen)") +
  theme(plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey40"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text     = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"))

print(p_fig1_mantel)

pdf(file.path(rep_racine, "Fig_Bloc8_Distance_decay_with_vs_without_Lyvet.pdf"),
    width = 7, height = 6)
print(p_fig1_mantel)
dev.off()

#  Figure 2: 3 capsules only (without Lyvet) 

build_mat_cap <- function(physeq_obj, capsule_name) {
  phy_pa  <- transform_sample_counts(physeq_obj, function(x) ifelse(x>0,1,0))
  otu_mat <- as.data.frame(otu_table(phy_pa))
  if(taxa_are_rows(phy_pa)) otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
  meta_dd         <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_pa))
  otu_mat$Site    <- trimws(meta_dd$Site)
  otu_mat$Capsule <- meta_dd$Capsule
  mat <- otu_mat %>%
    filter(Capsule == capsule_name, Site != "Lyvet") %>%
    select(-Capsule) %>%
    group_by(Site) %>%
    summarise(across(where(is.numeric), max), .groups="drop") %>%
    as.data.frame()
  rownames(mat) <- mat$Site; mat$Site <- NULL
  sites_ok <- intersect(site_order, rownames(mat))
  mat      <- mat[sites_ok, colSums(mat[sites_ok, ]) > 0, drop=FALSE]
  if(nrow(mat) < 3) return(NULL)
  mat
}

# Build pairs per capsule without Lyvet
get_pairs_cap <- function(mat_cap, capsule_name) {
  sites_c  <- rownames(mat_cap)
  dists    <- meta_sites$Distance[match(sites_c, meta_sites$Site)]
  dist_geo <- as.dist(outer(dists, dists, function(a,b) abs(a-b)))
  dist_eco <- vegdist(mat_cap, method="bray", binary=TRUE)
  set.seed(seed_global)
  mt <- mantel(dist_eco, dist_geo, method="pearson",
               permutations=n_perm_mantel)
  cat("\nMantel", capsule_name, "without Lyvet: r=", round(mt$statistic,3),
      "p=", round(mt$signif,4), "\n")
  geo_mat <- as.matrix(dist_geo)
  eco_mat <- as.matrix(dist_eco)
  idx     <- combn(length(sites_c), 2)
  data.frame(
    dist_geo  = geo_mat[lower.tri(geo_mat)],
    dist_eco  = eco_mat[lower.tri(eco_mat)],
    Capsule   = capsule_name,
    r_mantel  = round(mt$statistic, 3),
    p_mantel  = round(mt$signif, 4))
}

# Global without Lyvet pairs (kept for reference, NOT added to fig2)
sites_nl    <- rownames(mat_sp_nl)
dist_geo_nl <- outer(
```

# ==============================================================================
# BLOC 10 — Partition β-diversité (betapart, Sørensen)
# ==============================================================================

# Ce bloc analyse les mécanismes écologiques sous-jacents à la variation de composition entre sites le long du gradient.
# Ici toutes les PCRs sont agrégées par site (max de présence) pour obtenir une matrice site × espèce en présence/absence — une espèce vue dans au moins 1 PCR est considérée présente dans le site.
#
# beta.multi calcule les indices globaux de β-diversité de Sørensen pour l'ensemble des sites : 
#   - Bsor (dissimilarité totale) 
#   - Bsim (turnover = remplacement d'espèces) 
#   - Bnes (nestedness = appauvrissement progressif) 
# Avec la relation additive exacte Bsor = Bsim + Bnes — propriété spécifique à Sørensen qui permet cette décomposition sans résidu ==> voir formule dans le mémoire
#
# beta.pair calcule ces mêmes indices pour chaque paire de sites → heatmaps pairwise (Fig. Supp. 5 et 6). 2 heatmaps par capsule (Turnover et Nestedness)
#
# Un test de Wilcoxon apparié unilatéral (H1 : Bsim > Bnes) teste si le turnover domine significativement le nestedness sur l'ensemble des paires de sites 
# Ce qui est l'hypothèse attendue le long d'un gradient estuarien avec remplacement progressif des assemblages marins par des assemblages euryhalins puis dulçaquicoles.
#
# Toutes les analyses sont répétées : avec/sans Lyvet (global) et par capsule séparément (sans Lyvet) → Tableau 1 du mémoire.

```{r bloc7_betapart, eval=run_bloc7_betapart}

library(betapart)

prep_betapart_matrix <- function(physeq_obj) {
  phy_tax <- tax_glom(physeq_obj, taxrank="Species", NArm=TRUE)
  phy_tax <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(phy_tax)>0, phy_tax)
  phy_pa  <- transform_sample_counts(phy_tax, function(x) ifelse(x>0,1,0))
  otu_mat <- as.data.frame(otu_table(phy_pa))
  if(taxa_are_rows(phy_pa)) otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
  otu_mat$Site <- trimws(data.frame(sample_data(phy_pa))$Site)
  site_mat <- otu_mat %>%
    group_by(Site) %>%
    summarise(across(where(is.numeric),max),.groups="drop") %>%
    as.data.frame()
  rownames(site_mat) <- site_mat$Site; site_mat$Site <- NULL
  site_mat <- site_mat[intersect(site_order,rownames(site_mat)),]
  cat("Betapart matrix:", nrow(site_mat), "sites ×", ncol(site_mat), "species\n")
  return(site_mat)
}

mat_sp    <- prep_betapart_matrix(physeq_teleo)
beta_multi_res <- beta.multi(mat_sp, index.family="sorensen")

cat("\n=== Global beta-diversity partition ===\n")
data.frame(
  Bsor     = round(beta_multi_res$beta.SOR,3),
  Bsim     = round(beta_multi_res$beta.SIM,3),
  Bnes     = round(beta_multi_res$beta.SNE,3),
  Pct_turn = round(beta_multi_res$beta.SIM/beta_multi_res$beta.SOR*100,1)
) %>% print()

beta_pair <- beta.pair(mat_sp, index.family="sorensen")

plot_beta_heatmap <- function(dist_mat, titre, palette_high="#08306b") {
  df <- as.matrix(dist_mat) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Site1") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-Site1,names_to="Site2",values_to="value") %>%
    mutate(Site1=factor(trimws(Site1),levels=site_order),
           Site2=factor(trimws(Site2),levels=site_order))
  ggplot(df,aes(x=Site2,y=Site1,fill=value)) +
    geom_tile(color="white",linewidth=0.5) +
    geom_text(aes(label=round(value,2)),size=3,color="white",fontface="bold") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low="#f7fbff",high=palette_high,name="Value",limits=c(0,1)) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels=site_labels_court) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels=site_labels_court) + theme_bw() +
    labs(title=titre,x=NULL,y=NULL) +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=8,angle=30,hjust=1),
          axis.text.y=element_text(size=8),
          plot.title=element_text(face="bold",size=11))
}

p_b1 <- plot_beta_heatmap(beta_pair$beta.sor, "Total dissimilarity (Bsor)", "#252525")
p_b2 <- plot_beta_heatmap(beta_pair$beta.sim, "Turnover (Bsim)",             "#7f0000")
p_b3 <- plot_beta_heatmap(beta_pair$beta.sne, "Nestedness (Bnes)",           "#00441b")

p_beta_panel <- (p_b1 | p_b2 | p_b3) +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Pairwise beta-diversity partition",
    subtitle = "Bsor = Bsim + Bnes | Sørensen",
    theme    = theme(plot.title=element_text(face="bold",size=12)))

print(p_beta_panel)

pdf(file.path(rep_racine, "Fig_Bloc7_Betapart_heatmaps.pdf"),
    width=14, height=5)
print(p_beta_panel)
dev.off()

bsim_v <- as.dist(beta_pair$beta.sim)
bsne_v <- as.dist(beta_pair$beta.sne)
tw <- wilcox.test(as.vector(bsim_v), as.vector(bsne_v),
                   paired=TRUE, alternative="greater")
cat("\n=== Wilcoxon Turnover > Nestedness (with Lyvet) ===\n")
cat("p =", round(tw$p.value,4), "\n")

mat_sp_nl <- prep_betapart_matrix(
  prune_samples(sample_data(physeq_teleo)$Site!="Lyvet", physeq_teleo))

# Betapart avec Lyvet — Global + par capsule

beta_nl   <- beta.multi(mat_sp_nl, index.family="sorensen")

cat("\n=== Global beta-diversity partition — WITHOUT Lyvet ===\n")
data.frame(
  Bsor     = round(beta_nl$beta.SOR, 3),
  Bsim     = round(beta_nl$beta.SIM, 3),
  Bnes     = round(beta_nl$beta.SNE, 3),
  Pct_turn = round(beta_nl$beta.SIM / beta_nl$beta.SOR * 100, 1)) %>% print()

beta_pair_nl <- beta.pair(mat_sp_nl, index.family="sorensen")

# Wilcoxon global sans Lyvet
bsim_nl_v <- as.dist(beta_pair_nl$beta.sim)
bsne_nl_v <- as.dist(beta_pair_nl$beta.sne)
tw_nl <- wilcox.test(as.vector(bsim_nl_v), as.vector(bsne_nl_v),
                      paired=TRUE, alternative="greater")
cat("\n=== Wilcoxon Turnover > Nestedness (without Lyvet) ===\n")
cat("p =", round(tw_nl$p.value, 4), "\n")

# Heatmaps global sans Lyvet
p_nl_b1 <- plot_beta_heatmap(beta_pair_nl$beta.sor,
  "Total dissimilarity (Bsor) — without Lyvet", "#252525")
p_nl_b2 <- plot_beta_heatmap(beta_pair_nl$beta.sim,
  "Turnover (Bsim) — without Lyvet", "#7f0000")
p_nl_b3 <- plot_beta_heatmap(beta_pair_nl$beta.sne,
  "Nestedness (Bnes) — without Lyvet", "#00441b")

panel_beta_nl <- (p_nl_b1 | p_nl_b2 | p_nl_b3) +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "MiFish — Beta-diversity partition — Without Lyvet",
    subtitle = "Bsor = Bsim + Bnes | Sørensen | Species level",
    theme    = theme(plot.title=element_text(face="bold", size=12)))
print(panel_beta_nl)
pdf(file.path(rep_racine, "Fig_Bloc7_MiFish_Betapart_Global_without_Lyvet.pdf"),
    width=14, height=5)
print(panel_beta_nl)
dev.off()

# Betapart par capsule — sans Lyvet

cat("\n=== Betapart per capsule — WITHOUT Lyvet ===\n")

recap_bp_cap <- do.call(rbind, lapply(capsules_principales, function(cap) {
  phy_cap <- prune_samples(
    sample_data(physeq_teleo)$Capsule == cap &
    sample_data(physeq_teleo)$Site    != "Lyvet",
    physeq_teleo)
  phy_cap <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(phy_cap) > 0, phy_cap)
  phy_cap <- prune_samples(sample_sums(phy_cap) > 0, phy_cap)
  if(nsamples(phy_cap) < 4) return(NULL)

  mat <- tryCatch(prep_betapart_matrix(phy_cap), error=function(e) NULL)
  if(is.null(mat) || nrow(mat) < 3) return(NULL)

  bm <- tryCatch(beta.multi(mat, index.family="sorensen"), error=function(e) NULL)
  if(is.null(bm)) return(NULL)

  bp <- tryCatch(beta.pair(mat, index.family="sorensen"), error=function(e) NULL)

  # Wilcoxon turnover vs nestedness
  p_wilcox <- NA
  if(!is.null(bp)) {
    tw_cap <- tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(as.vector(as.dist(bp$beta.sim)),
                  as.vector(as.dist(bp$beta.sne)),
                  paired=TRUE, alternative="greater"),
      error=function(e) NULL)
    if(!is.null(tw_cap)) p_wilcox <- round(tw_cap$p.value, 4)
  }

  cat("\nCapsule:", cap, "\n")
  cat("  Bsor=", round(bm$beta.SOR,3),
      "Bsim=", round(bm$beta.SIM,3),
      "Bnes=", round(bm$beta.SNE,3),
      "| %Turn=", round(bm$beta.SIM/bm$beta.SOR*100,1),
      "| Wilcoxon p=", p_wilcox, "\n")

  # Heatmaps par capsule + exports PDF séparés
  if(!is.null(bp)) {
    ph_sim <- plot_beta_heatmap(bp$beta.sim,
      paste0("Turnover (Bsim) — ", cap, " — without Lyvet"), "#7f0000")
    ph_sne <- plot_beta_heatmap(bp$beta.sne,
      paste0("Nestedness (Bnes) — ", cap, " — without Lyvet"), "#00441b")

    panel_cap <- (ph_sim | ph_sne) +
      plot_annotation(
        title    = paste0("MiFish — Beta-diversity partition — ", cap, " — Without Lyvet"),
        subtitle = paste0("Bsor=", round(bm$beta.SOR,3),
                           " | Bsim=", round(bm$beta.SIM,3),
                           " | Bnes=", round(bm$beta.SNE,3),
                           " | %Turnover=", round(bm$beta.SIM/bm$beta.SOR*100,1), "%"),
        theme=theme(plot.title=element_text(face="bold", size=11),
                    plot.subtitle=element_text(size=9, color="grey40")))
    print(panel_cap)

    # PDF combiné Turnover + Nestedness
    pdf(file.path(rep_racine,
                  paste0("Fig_Bloc7_MiFish_Betapart_", cap, "_without_Lyvet.pdf")),
        width=10, height=5)
    print(panel_cap)
    dev.off()

    # PDF séparé Turnover
    pdf(file.path(rep_racine,
                  paste0("Fig_Bloc7_MiFish_Betapart_", cap, "_Turnover_without_Lyvet.pdf")),
        width=6, height=5)
    print(ph_sim)
    dev.off()

    # PDF séparé Nestedness
    pdf(file.path(rep_racine,
                  paste0("Fig_Bloc7_MiFish_Betapart_", cap, "_Nestedness_without_Lyvet.pdf")),
        width=6, height=5)
    print(ph_sne)
    dev.off()

    cat("  --> PDFs Turnover et Nestedness exportés séparément pour", cap, "\n")
  }

  data.frame(Capsule=cap, n_sites=nrow(mat),
             Bsor=round(bm$beta.SOR,3), Bsim=round(bm$beta.SIM,3),
             Bnes=round(bm$beta.SNE,3),
             Pct_turn=round(bm$beta.SIM/bm$beta.SOR*100,1),
             Wilcoxon_p=p_wilcox)
}))

cat("\n=== Betapart summary per capsule — without Lyvet ===\n")
print(recap_bp_cap, row.names=FALSE)

```

```{r bloc9_dce, eval=run_bloc9_dce}
library(ggVennDiagram)

  "Maja brachydactyla", "Carcinus maenas", "Necora puber",
  "Liocarcinus arcuatus", "Liocarcinus depurator")

  theme_combmatrix(combmatrix.label.text=element_text(size=9,face="bold"),
                   combmatrix.panel.point.size=4,
                   combmatrix.panel.line.size=0.8) +
  labs(title    = "UpSet — Detection intersections by method",
       subtitle = paste0("Sites: ",
         paste(site_labels_court[sites_dce_edna], collapse=", ")),
       x=NULL, y="Nb species") +
  theme(plot.title=element_text(face="bold",size=12),
        legend.position="bottom")

print(p_upset2)

pdf(file.path(rep_racine, "Fig_Bloc9_UpSet_detection_by_method.pdf"),
    width=10, height=7)
print(p_upset2)
dev.off()

```

# ==============================================================================
# BLOC 12 — Functional profile (DCE multi-years)
# ==============================================================================

# Ce bloc évalue si, au-delà des différences taxonomiques, l'eDNA et la DCE capturent un profil fonctionnel similaire de la communauté ichtyologique.
#
# Pour chaque liste d'espèces (eDNA 2025, DCE 2025, DCE 4 ans) on calcule la proportion d'espèces portant chaque modalité de trois traits fonctionnels : guilde trophique (Invertivore,
# Omnivore, Piscivore, Planktivore), position d'alimentation (Benthique, Pélagique) et tolérance à la salinité (Marine, Euryhaline, Eau douce). 
# Les traits sont issus de Nils Teichert (Station Biologique de Dinard) via la table Traits_MiFish.txt complétée par un patch manuel pour 6 espèces DCE absentes de la base.
#
# La comparaison est visuelle et descriptive (proportions en barplots empilés).
# La question est : les deux approches brossent-elles le même tableau fonctionnel de la communauté même si elles ne détectent pas exactement les mêmes espèces ? → Fig. 7.

```{r bloc10_functional_profile, eval=run_bloc10_dce}

# Functional profile (DCE multi-years)
traits_raw <- read.table(fichier_traits, sep="\t", header=TRUE,
                          stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

traits_teleo <- traits_raw %>%
  filter(Class == "Teleostei", not_a_contaminant == TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Feeding_position), Feeding_position != "") %>%
  mutate(Species_full = case_when(
    !is.na(Species) & Species != "NA" ~ paste(Genus, Species),
    !is.na(Genus)   & Genus   != "NA" ~ paste(Genus, "sp."),
    TRUE ~ paste(Family, "sp."))) %>%
  group_by(Species_full) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup()

cat("Feeding_position :", sort(unique(traits_teleo$Feeding_position)), "\n")
cat("Trophic_guild    :", sort(unique(traits_teleo$Trophic_guild)),    "\n")
cat("Salinity_Tolerance:", sort(unique(traits_teleo$Salinity_Tolerance)), "\n")

fichier_dce_annees          <- "DCE_Especes_4_annees.txt"
taxa_non_poisson_dce_multi  <- c(
  "Maja brachydactyla","Carcinus maenas","Necora puber",
  "Liocarcinus arcuatus","Liocarcinus depurator")

annee_colors <- c("2012"="#1b7837","2013"="#2171b5",
                   "2014"="#d95f02","2025"="#7b3294")

if(!exists("dce_multi_poissons")) {
  dce_multi <- read.table(
    file.path(rep_racine, fichier_dce_annees),
    sep="\t", header=TRUE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  dce_multi$Species_full <- trimws(gsub("_"," ",dce_multi$nom))
  dce_multi$annee        <- as.character(dce_multi$annee)
  dce_multi_poissons     <- dce_multi %>%
    filter(!Species_full %in% taxa_non_poisson_dce_multi)
  dce_par_annee     <- tapply(dce_multi_poissons$Species_full,
                               dce_multi_poissons$annee,
                               function(x) sort(unique(x)))
  dce_toutes_annees <- sort(unique(dce_multi_poissons$Species_full))
  dce_2025          <- dce_par_annee[["2025"]]
}

traits_manuels_ajout <- data.frame(
  Species_full       = c(
    "Chelidonichthys lucernus", "Gobiusculus flavescens",
    "Labrus bergylta",          "Pleuronectes platessa",
    "Raja undulata",            "Zeus faber"),
  Trophic_guild      = c("Invertivore", "Planktivore", "Invertivore",
                          "Invertivore", "Invertivore", "Piscivore"),
  Feeding_position   = c("Benthic",  "Pelagic",  "Benthic",
                          "Benthic",  "Benthic",  "Pelagic"),
  Salinity_Tolerance = c("Marine",    "Marine",   "Marine",
                          "Euryhaline","Marine",   "Marine"),
  Max_size           = c(60, 6, 60, 100, 120, 90),
  stringsAsFactors   = FALSE)

dce_sans_traits <- setdiff(dce_toutes_annees, traits_teleo$Species_full)
traits_manuels_ajout <- traits_manuels_ajout %>%
  filter(Species_full %in% dce_sans_traits)

if(nrow(traits_manuels_ajout) > 0) {
  cols_extra <- setdiff(colnames(traits_teleo), colnames(traits_manuels_ajout))
  for(col in cols_extra) traits_manuels_ajout[[col]] <- NA
  traits_manuels_ajout <- traits_manuels_ajout[, colnames(traits_teleo), drop=FALSE]
  traits_teleo <- bind_rows(traits_teleo, traits_manuels_ajout)
  cat("Trait patch:", nrow(traits_manuels_ajout), "species added\n")
}

if(!exists("edna_all_sp")) {
  phy_dce_sites <- prune_samples(
    trimws(sample_data(physeq_sp)$Site) %in% sites_dce_edna, physeq_sp)
  phy_dce_sites <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(phy_dce_sites)>0, phy_dce_sites)
  tax_dce       <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy_dce_sites))
  edna_all_sp   <- paste(tax_dce$Genus, tax_dce$Species)
  edna_par_filter <- lapply(setNames(capsules_principales,capsules_principales),
    function(cap){
      phy_c <- prune_samples(sample_data(phy_dce_sites)$Capsule==cap, phy_dce_sites)
      phy_c <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(phy_c)>0, phy_c)
      tax_c <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy_c))
      paste(tax_c$Genus, tax_c$Species)
    })
}

traits_cat       <- c("Trophic_guild","Feeding_position","Salinity_Tolerance")
traits_cat_dispo <- intersect(traits_cat, colnames(traits_teleo))
trait_labels     <- c(
  "Trophic_guild"      = "Trophic guild",
  "Feeding_position"   = "Feeding position",
  "Salinity_Tolerance" = "Salinity tolerance")

calc_trait_prop <- function(sp_list, trait_col) {
  df <- traits_teleo %>%
    filter(Species_full %in% sp_list,
           !is.na(.data[[trait_col]]),
           .data[[trait_col]] != "") %>%
    select(Species_full, val = all_of(trait_col)) %>%
    distinct(Species_full, .keep_all=TRUE)
  if(nrow(df)==0) return(NULL)
  df %>% count(val) %>%
    mutate(prop=n/sum(n)*100, Trait=trait_col, Modalite=val)
}

COL_EDNA  <- "#1b7837"
groupes_3 <- list(
  "eDNA (all caps.)" = edna_all_sp,
  "DCE 2025"         = dce_2025,
  "DCE 4 years"      = dce_toutes_annees)

couleurs_groupes_3 <- c(
  "eDNA (all caps.)" = COL_EDNA,
  "DCE 2025"         = "#7b3294",
  "DCE 4 years"      = "#d95f02")

traits_3 <- c("Trophic_guild","Feeding_position","Salinity_Tolerance")
traits_3_labels <- c(
  "Trophic_guild"      = "Trophic guild",
  "Feeding_position"   = "Feeding position",
  "Salinity_Tolerance" = "Salinity tolerance")

df_3grp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(traits_3, function(tr) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(groupes_3), function(grp) {
    res <- calc_trait_prop(groupes_3[[grp]], tr)
    if(is.null(res)) return(NULL)
    n_sp <- length(intersect(groupes_3[[grp]],
      traits_teleo$Species_full[!is.na(traits_teleo[[tr]])]))
    res %>% mutate(Groupe=grp, Trait=tr,
                    Trait_label=traits_3_labels[tr], N_sp=n_sp)
  }))
})) %>%
  mutate(
    Groupe      = factor(Groupe, levels=c("eDNA (all caps.)","DCE 2025","DCE 4 years")),
    Trait_label = factor(Trait_label, levels=unname(traits_3_labels)))

make_bar_trait <- function(tr) {
  df  <- df_3grp %>% filter(Trait==tr)
  tl  <- traits_3_labels[tr]
  mods  <- sort(unique(df$Modalite))
  n_mod <- length(mods)
  pal <- if(n_mod<=8)
    setNames(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(max(3,n_mod),"Set2"), mods)
  else
    setNames(colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8,"Set2"))(n_mod), mods)

  n_annot <- df %>% group_by(Groupe) %>% slice(1) %>%
    select(Groupe,N_sp) %>% ungroup()

  ggplot(df, aes(x=Groupe, y=prop, fill=Modalite)) +
    geom_col(position="stack", width=0.65, color="white", linewidth=0.5) +
    geom_text(aes(label=ifelse(prop>=8, paste0(round(prop,0),"%"), "")),
              position=position_stack(vjust=0.5),
              size=3.2, fontface="bold", color="white") +
    geom_text(data=n_annot,
              aes(x=Groupe, y=-5, label=paste0("n=",N_sp), fill=NULL),
              size=2.8, color="grey50", fontface="italic",
              inherit.aes=FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=pal, name=tl) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels=function(x) gsub(" ","\n",x)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,100,25),
                       labels=function(x) paste0(x,"%"),
                       limits=c(-8,107),
                       expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0))) +
    theme_bw(base_size=11) +
    labs(title=tl, x=NULL, y="Proportion (%)") +
    theme(
      plot.title         = element_text(face="bold", size=11, hjust=0.5),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(size=9, face="bold",
                                         color=unname(couleurs_groupes_3)),
      axis.text.y        = element_text(size=8),
      legend.title       = element_text(face="bold", size=8.5),
      legend.text        = element_text(size=8),
      legend.key.size    = unit(0.4,"cm"),
      legend.position    = "right",
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      plot.margin        = margin(6,4,10,4))
}

p_tr1 <- make_bar_trait("Trophic_guild")
p_tr2 <- make_bar_trait("Feeding_position")
p_tr3 <- make_bar_trait("Salinity_Tolerance")

p_functional <- (p_tr1 | p_tr2 | p_tr3) +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Functional profile: eDNA vs DCE",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Proportion (%) of each modality  |  ",
      "n = species with available trait\n",
      "eDNA sites: ",
      paste(site_labels_court[sites_dce_edna], collapse=", ")),
    theme = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face="bold",size=13,hjust=0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size=9,color="grey40",
                                    hjust=0.5,lineheight=1.4),
      plot.margin   = margin(12,14,12,14),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill="white",color=NA)))

print(p_functional)

pdf(file.path(rep_racine, "Fig_Bloc10_Functional_profile_eDNA_vs_DCE.pdf"),
    width=13, height=6)
print(p_functional)
dev.off()
```
